entities.summary: Philipp Kirkorov (b. 1967-04-30, Varna) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Varna and Russia. Known in the fields of russia, composers & musicians, europe.
